text_block_list.text:
And Эйр Грув is in the lead! She's
done it!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув has made history on the turf
today as
she continues her mother's
legacy! We have a new
queen today!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I... really won?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You were amazing, Эйр Грув! Three
cheers for
the new queen!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
Hip hip hooray! Congrats on following
your
mother's legacy!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text:
It's real... I'm the new Queen of the
Oaks. Which
means...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Just... wow...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I wish I could be like her... So proud and
majestic.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I go to greet Эйр Грув after her
incredible
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes... I've finally made it.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...I have to admit that even I cannot
contain my
emotions right now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Today, I was able to see the same view
my mother
did.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...You've done well yourself.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You are aware that this is not the end,
correct? In
fact, this is only the
beginning.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Next is the Shuka Sho. We need to stay
focused
and keep our eyes on the prize.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: You're sounding like a queen already.

text_block_list.text:
Heh... you're not sounding too bad
yourself.
When did you get so reliable?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Keep that up from here on out, and
there may be
hope for you yet.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув graces me with a regal smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
